title: Community vote on a lexical entry (one line of votes/votes.jsonl)
description: A vote is a signal, not evidence. The effective vote is the latest vote per voter, entry and kind; an agree and a disagree from one voter count once, on the later of the two. Rows without a voter identity are ignored. scripts/votes_check.py enforces this schema.

spelling.description: Required for kind spelling; must be null otherwise. No control characters.

region.description: Free text such as north, south, city, rural.

voter.description: Lower-case GitHub login. Null or missing means the vote is ignored.
